name: Sleep Arrow
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, magus 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (sand), F (a dart)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Effect one magical arrow
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

An arrow, glowing like a star at night, springs from your hand and speeds to its target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to affect the target. If hit, the target must make a Will save or fall asleep as per the sleep spell for 1 minute/level, with no HD limit. On a successful saving throw, the target is fatigued for 1 minute.
